verdict.rationale: Devin's API supports creating sessions on behalf of any user and building automated workflows, plus scheduling/recurring session creation, which enables launching many concurrent agent tasks for a team lead — this is a real, documented capability (devin-docs-8, devin-docs-9, devin-docs-15, devin-docs-17). However, there is no first-party or independent evidence of large-scale concurrent usage in practice, dashboards for managing many simultaneous sessions, or success-rate data at scale; community discussion instead flags low task-resolution rates (13.8%) which raises doubts about throughput quality once scaled. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of running many concurrent sessions successfully, documentation of concurrency limits or a fleet-management UI, and data on success rates at scale.
